comparison.objective: Level a floor sleeper using a tapered shim.
comparison.physical_skill: Drive a wedge to a precise depth while preserving support bearing and level placement.
comparison.success_condition: Sleeper level within tolerance, fully bearing shim under it, level left on top, hands clear and state stable; falls fail.
comparison.reason: Wedge insertion and geometric leveling test quasi-static adjustment, not screening or bridge-clearing.
